name: sticky-scroll-stack-motion
title: Sticky Scroll Stack (Motion)
author: AlgorizeTech
description: A sticky section whose panels swap content as you scroll, supporting list, image, split and custom layouts. Use it for feature sections with varied content per step.
docs: Motion build of `sticky-scroll-stack` — same props, markup and install path; install one or the other. Named export: StickyScrollStack. Each item sets `contentType` (list | image | split | custom) so steps need not share a shape. Uses next/image, so it needs edits outside Next.js.
